indication: hyperphosphatemia in patients with chronic kidney disease on dialysis
iron deficiency anemia in adult patients with chronic kidney disease not on dialysis
single_dose: 2 tablets orally three times per day for hyperphosphatemia
1 tablet orally 3 times per day for iron deficiency anemia
dosage_frequency: three times per day with meals for hyperphosphatemia
three times per day with meals for iron deficiency anemia
mechanism_of_action: binds dietary phosphate in the GI tract and precipitates as ferric phosphate, lowering serum phosphorus levels for hyperphosphatemia
reduces iron deficiency anemia by providing ferrous iron that can be incorporated into hemoglobin
